Dim submitted As Boolean

Sub Form_Load()
    Me.Caption = "Northstar Systems — Digital Engineering"
    lblStatus.Caption = "We usually reply within two working days."
End Sub

Sub btnSend_Click()
    If Len(Trim(txtName.Text)) = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Please enter your name."
        txtName.SetFocus
    ElseIf Instr(txtEmail.Text, "@") = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Please enter a valid email address."
        txtEmail.SetFocus
    ElseIf Len(Trim(txtMessage.Text)) = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Please tell us a little about your project."
        txtMessage.SetFocus
    Else
        lblStatus.Caption = "Thanks, " & txtName.Text & "! Your enquiry is ready. (Demo form)"
        btnSend.Caption = "Enquiry received ✓"
        submitted = True
    End If
End Sub
